steps.title: Name your story
steps.text: Your story's name is in the project's settings. The title screen and an exported game show it.

steps.title: Rewrite the opening
steps.text: Each scene is ink. Change who comes aboard, and how they're described.

steps.title: Change a choice
steps.text: Ines's scene sets a flag for each answer. Add a third answer, and set a flag of its own.

steps.title: Add a passenger
steps.text: The crossing sheet opens a scene at each leg. Write a scene, then give it a row here, and raise LEGS in the ferry script.

steps.title: Change what an ending needs
steps.text: The landing picks the ending from the flags the night set.

steps.title: Change what the journal says
steps.text: Each passenger is a quest: its stages are what the journal shows.

steps.title: Recolour it
steps.text: Six colours, a typeface and a size are the whole theme.

steps.title: Play it
steps.text: Play your changes here, and keep a state to come back to a scene.

steps.title: Export it
steps.text: Export a web build, a single file or an itch.io zip from the Project panel.
